title: Heterogeneous condensates of transcription factors in embryonic stem cells: Molecular simulations.
authors: Mizutani, Azuki; Tan, Cheng; Sugita, Yuji; Takada, Shoji
one_liner_zh: 该文用残基分辨率分子动力学模拟研究胚胎干细胞中四种转录因子（Oct4/Sox2/Klf4/Nanog）异质凝聚体的形成与互作机制，虽聚焦相分离而非TF-DNA结合，但以TF为对象且用物理模拟方法，对TF互作建模有借鉴意义。
abstract: Biomolecular condensates formed via liquid-liquid phase separation are ubiquitous in cells, especially in the nucleus. While condensates containing one or two kinds of biomolecules have been relatively well characterized, those with more heterogeneous biomolecular components and interactions between biomolecules inside are largely unknown. This study used residue-resolution molecular dynamics simulations to investigate heterogeneous protein assemblies that include four master transcription factors in mammalian embryonic stem cells: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and Nanog. Molecular dynamics simulations of the mixture systems showed highly heterogeneous and dynamic behaviors; protein condensates mainly contain Sox2, Klf4, and Nanog, while most Oct4 are dissolved into the dilute phase. The condensate forms loosely interacting clusters where Klf4 is the most abundant, suggesting that Klf4 serves as a scaffold of the condensate, and Sox2 and Nanog are bound to Klf4 for stabilizing the condensate. Oct4 is moderately recruited to the condensate, serving as a client mainly via its interaction with Sox2. This study highlights the importance of intermolecular interaction between different transcription factors on the condensate formations with heterogeneous biomolecular components.
abstract_zh: 通过液-液相分离形成的生物分子凝聚体在细胞中普遍存在，尤其在细胞核内。尽管含有一种或两种生物分子的凝聚体已被相对充分表征，但那些包含更异质性生物分子组分及其内部生物分子间相互作用的凝聚体在很大程度上仍属未知。本研究采用残基分辨率的分子动力学模拟，探究了哺乳动物胚胎干细胞中四种主转录因子——Oct4、Sox2、Klf4和Nanog——所构成的异质性蛋白质组装体。混合体系的分子动力学模拟显示出高度异质性和动态行为；蛋白质凝聚体主要包含Sox2、Klf4和Nanog，而大部分Oct4则溶解于稀相中。凝聚体形成松散相互作用的簇，其中Klf4最为丰富，表明Klf4充当凝聚体的支架，而Sox2和Nanog与Klf4结合以稳定凝聚体。Oct4被适度招募至凝聚体，主要通过其与Sox2的相互作用作为客户蛋白。本研究强调了不同转录因子之间的分子间相互作用对具有异质性生物分子组分的凝聚体形成的重要性。
